visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a professional white chef's coat stands in a blurred kitchen studio environment. He gestures with his right arm toward a white circular induction cooker sitting on a wooden countertop. Bright studio lighting illuminates the scene uniformly. (2) Close-up shot of the white récolte induction cooker. A finger touches the side rim, revealing a hidden digital touch control panel that glows with numbers. The surface is glossy and clean. (3) The camera zooms in on food being cooked on a wide, white ceramic-coated flat pan. Meat skewers are sizzling, and later two eggs are fried side-by-side. The man's hands are seen using a spatula. (4) A split-screen montage displays four distinct cooking scenarios: frying meat, boiling soup in a ceramic pot, deep-frying noodles, and slow-cooking meat. Each quadrant has a label. (5) The man returns to a medium shot, holding a printed cookbook and pointing directly at the camera with an enthusiastic facial expression. Promotional graphics with yellow and orange text boxes occupy the top and bottom of the frame. (6) The man stands behind the induction cooker and accessories, gesturing expansively with both hands as detailed price information and discount codes appear as static overlays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins immediately alongside a fast-tempo electronic pop BGM. The speaker introduces the product with high vocal arousal and clear articulation. (2) A crisp digital 'blip' UI sound effect plays as the cooker is turned on, followed by a bright 'whoosh' transition effect. (3) Sizzling sound effects (pink noise transients) are layered under the narration as the food hits the pan. The BGM maintains a steady 4/4 beat. (4) A 'ding' sound effect highlights the transition to the split-screen demonstration. The speaker's pitch rises with excitement while mentioning convenience. (5) The speaker lets out a sharp vocal exclamation 'Super hungry!', signaling a shift to the final promotional call-to-action. (6) The BGM continues as a bright bed while the speaker delivers the final price and discount code details with an authoritative yet friendly professional tone.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Showcase -> Practical Use -> Promotion/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the co-branded IH induction cooker bundle from récolte and 'Great Men's Chef' for Mother's Day, emphasizing its aesthetic design, versatile cooking modes, and current discount offers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the product, brand logos prominently displayed, and a specific promotional discount code provided.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly polished commercial edit typical of social media marketing, using rapid cuts and high-density text overlays to maintain viewer engagement.
